title: Dacy's Elytra Crafting Recipe
description: This data-pack adds an elytra crafting recipe!
body:
This data-pack adds an elytra crafting recipe! This is useful for servers that have lots of players and not enough end ships or for survival players that simply dont need to go to the end or cant. 
Here is an image of the crafting recipe:


![Elytra Crafting Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/60ff3112c2e489ff3287ccb71be02c88642e042f.png)
